## file path and range
```{r}
# 1. 读取数据
reg_info_full <- readRDS(reg_sample_info_path)
reg_info <- reg_info_full |>
  filter(is_selected == TRUE)

# 定义要处理的图层
layers <- c("dem", "vegh", "twi", "rin", "slope", "aspect",
            "r_h_twi_30m_500m", "p_h_twi_30m_500m", "r_h_rin_30m_500m", "p_h_rin_30m_500m",
            "r_h_twi_30_5000", "p_h_twi_30_5000", "r_h_rin_30_5000", "p_h_rin_30_5000")

# 为每个区域提取信息
for (i in 1:nrow(reg_info)) {
  reg_id <- reg_info$strata_label[i]
  
  # 对每个图层
  for (layer in layers) {
    # 构建文件路径
    if (layer %in% c("dem", "vegh", "twi", "rin", "slope", "aspect")) {
      file_path <- file.path(reg_validate_dir, paste0(reg_id, "_", layer, "_30m.tif"))
    } else if (grepl("500m", layer)) {
      file_path <- file.path(reg_validate_dir, paste0(reg_id, "_", layer, ".tif"))
    } else {
      file_path <- file.path(reg_validate_dir, paste0(reg_id, "_", layer, ".tif"))
    }
    
    # 添加文件路径列
    reg_info[i, paste0(layer, "_file")] <- file_path
    
    # 提取范围
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      tryCatch({
        r <- terra::rast(file_path)
        v <- terra::values(r, mat = FALSE)
        v <- v[!is.na(v)]
        if (length(v) > 0) {
          reg_info[i, paste0(layer, "_min")] <- min(v)
          reg_info[i, paste0(layer, "_max")] <- max(v)
          reg_info[i, paste0(layer, "_mean")] <- mean(v)
        }
      }, error = function(e) {})
    }
  }
}

global_ranges <- list()
for (layer in layers) {
  global_ranges[[layer]] <- c(
    min(reg_info[[paste0(layer, "_min")]], na.rm = TRUE),
    max(reg_info[[paste0(layer, "_max")]], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

## ploting function
```{r,fig.width=6,fig.height=8}
generate_region_plots <- function(reg_row, text_size = 7) {
  
  # --- Region info ---
  reg_id <- reg_row$strata_label
  reg_extent <- terra::ext(reg_row$xmin, reg_row$xmax, reg_row$ymin, reg_row$ymax)
  reg_xmid <- (reg_row$xmin + reg_row$xmax) / 2
  reg_ymid <- (reg_row$ymin + reg_row$ymax) / 2
  align_30m <- create_aligned_template(reg_extent, res_out = 0.00025)
  
  # ----- Plot config -----
  x_step <- reg_extent[2] - reg_extent[1]
  y_step <- reg_extent[4] - reg_extent[3]
  aspect_ratio <- (reg_extent[4] - reg_extent[3]) / (reg_extent[2] - reg_extent[1])
  
  # --- Reset theme for plots ---
  base_theme <- ggplot2::theme(
    aspect.ratio = aspect_ratio,
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title.position = "top",
    legend.justification = c(0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = text_size,
                                        angle = 0,
                                        hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
                                        margin = margin(b = 0)),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = text_size,
                                         angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 1),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = text_size,
                                        angle = 0,
                                        hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5,
                                        margin = margin(t = 1)),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.3) ,
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = text_size,
                                        angle = 0,
                                        hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,
                                        margin = margin(r = 1)),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.3) ,
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "cm"),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
      size = text_size,
      face = "plain",
      margin = margin(b = 0)
    ),
    plot.title.position = "panel"
  )
  
  my_guides <- guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    label.position = "bottom",
    label.hjust = 0,
    barwidth = 4.8, 
    barheight = 0.3,
    label.theme = element_text(
      size = text_size,
      margin = margin(r = 2, l = 2)
    )
  ))
  
  # --- Plotting ---
  p_location <- plot_single_sample_location(
    reg_xmid, reg_ymid, 
    # title_text = "Location", 
    title_text = "", 
    text_size = text_size
  ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      aspect.ratio = aspect_ratio, 
      plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 0, l = 1)
    )
  
  p_google <- plot_google_img(
    extent = reg_extent, 
    # title_text = "Google Satellite", 
    title_text = "", 
    text_size = text_size, 
    x_step = x_step, 
    y_step = y_step
  ) +
    base_theme + 
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 0, l = 1))
  
  p_dem <- plot_dem(
    reg_row$dem_file, 
    extent = reg_extent, 
    limits = global_ranges$dem,
    fill = "Elv (km)", 
    title_text = "", 
    text_size = text_size, 
    x_step = x_step, 
    y_step = y_step
  ) +
    base_theme + my_guides + 
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 0, l = 1))
  
  p_vegh <- plot_vegh(
    reg_row$vegh_file, 
    extent = reg_extent, 
    limits = global_ranges$vegh,
    fill = "H (m)", 
    title_text = "", 
    text_size = text_size, 
    x_step = x_step, 
    y_step = y_step
  ) +
    base_theme + my_guides + 
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 0, l = 1))
  
  p_twi <- plot_twi(
    reg_row$twi_file, 
    extent = reg_extent, 
    limits = global_ranges$twi,
    fill = "TWI", 
    title_text = "", 
    text_size = text_size, 
    x_step = x_step, 
    y_step = y_step
  ) +
    base_theme + my_guides + 
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 0, l = 1))
  
  p_rin <- plot_rin(
    reg_row$rin_file, 
    extent = reg_extent, 
    limits = global_ranges$rin,
    fill = "Rᵢₙ", 
    title_text = "", 
    text_size = text_size, 
    x_step = x_step, 
    y_step = y_step
  ) +
    base_theme + my_guides + 
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 0, l = 1))
  p_rA <- plot_cor_twi_vegh(
    reg_row$r_h_twi_30m_500m_file, 
    extent = reg_extent, 
    fill = "r(H,TWI)", 
    title_text = "", 
    text_size = text_size, 
    x_step = x_step, 
    y_step = y_step
  ) +
    base_theme + my_guides + 
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 0, l = 1))
  
  p_rB <- plot_r_H_R(
    reg_row$r_h_rin_30m_500m_file, 
    extent = reg_extent, 
    fill = "r(H,Rᵢₙ)", 
    title_text = "", 
    text_size = text_size, 
    x_step = x_step, 
    y_step = y_step
  ) +
    base_theme + my_guides + 
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 0, l = 1))
  
  # ---- x=r30; y=r450 ----
    
  r_h_twi_30 <- rast(reg_row$r_h_twi_30_5000_file)
  r_h_twi_450 <- rast(cor_twi_vegh_mosaic_file) |> crop(reg_extent)
  r_h_rin_30 <- rast(reg_row$r_h_rin_30_5000_file)
  r_h_rin_450 <- rast(r_H_R_5km_path) |> crop(reg_extent)
  stacked <- c(r_h_twi_30, r_h_twi_450, r_h_rin_30, r_h_rin_450)
  names(stacked) <- c("r_twi_30", "r_twi_450", "r_rin_30", "r_rin_450")
  df_sens <- as.data.frame(stacked, xy = FALSE) |> 
    tidyr::drop_na() |>
    dplyr::mutate(reg_id = reg_id)
  
  p_validA <- plot_scatter_r_validation(
    input_x = reg_row$r_h_twi_30_5000_file,
    input_y = cor_twi_vegh_mosaic_file,
    # title_text = bquote("Comparison " * r[.("H")*","*.("TWI")]),
    title_text = "", 
    text_size = text_size
  ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "none", 
      plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)
    )
  
  p_rA2 <- plot_cor_twi_vegh(
    cor_twi_vegh_mosaic_file, 
    extent = reg_extent, 
    fill = "r(H,TWI)", 
    title_text = "", 
    text_size = text_size, 
    x_step = x_step, 
    y_step = y_step
  ) +
    base_theme + my_guides + 
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 0, l = 1))
  
  p_validB <- plot_scatter_r_validation(
    reg_row$r_h_rin_30_5000_file, 
    r_H_R_5km_path, 
    # title_text = bquote("Comparison " * r[.("H")*","*.("Rᵢₙ")]), 
    title_text = "", 
    text_size = text_size
  ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "none", 
      plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)
    )
  
  p_rB2 <- plot_r_H_R(
    r_H_R_5km_path, 
    extent = reg_extent, 
    fill = "r(H,Rᵢₙ)", 
    title_text = "", 
    text_size = text_size, 
    x_step = x_step, 
    y_step = y_step
  ) +
    base_theme + my_guides + 
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 0, l = 1))
  
  # ----- 返回所有图（按行排列的顺序）-----
  return(list(
    # 第一行：Location | Google | DEM | Vegh
    p_location = p_location,
    p_google = p_google,
    p_dem = p_dem,
    p_vegh = p_vegh,
    # 第二行：TWI | rA (500m) | Rin | rB (500m)
    p_twi = p_twi,
    p_rA = p_rA,
    p_rin = p_rin,
    p_rB = p_rB,
    # 第三行：validA | rA2 (5km) | validB | rB2 (5km)
    p_validA = p_validA,
    p_rA2 = p_rA2,
    p_validB = p_validB,
    p_rB2 = p_rB2,
    # 额外信息（便于后续使用）
    reg_id = reg_id,
    reg_extent = reg_extent,
    df_sens = df_sens
  ))
}

tictoc::tic()

all_regions_plots <- lapply(1:nrow(reg_info), function(i) {
  generate_region_plots(
    reg_row = reg_info[i, ],
    text_size = 6
  )
})

# 3. 提取所有区域的各个图（按图类型）

tictoc::toc()
```

## plot: dem vegh twi rin 
```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=8, dpi = 300}
tictoc::tic()

# 为每一列创建一个组合图，并统一该列的图例
col1 <- wrap_plots(p_dem_list, ncol = 1) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

col2 <- wrap_plots(p_vegh_list, ncol = 1) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

col3 <- wrap_plots(p_twi_list, ncol = 1) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

col4 <- wrap_plots(p_rin_list, ncol = 1) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# 组合成最终图（每列有自己的图例）
create_row_labels_column <- function(labels) {
  # 为每个标签创建一个ggplot对象
  label_plots <- lapply(labels, function(label) {
    ggplot() + 
      annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = label, 
               angle = 0, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
      theme_void() +
      theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  })
  
  # 纵向组合所有标签
  wrap_plots(label_plots, ncol = 1)
}

row_labels_text <- c("Hyper\narid", "Arid", "Semiarid", "Dry\nsubhumid", "Humid", "Perhumid")  # 替换为你的实际标签
row_label_column <- create_row_labels_column(row_labels_text)

# 现在直接合并：标签列 + col1 + col2 + col3 + col4
final_plot <- (row_label_column | col1 | col2 | col3 | col4) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 5, widths = c(0.5, 1, 1, 1, 1))  # 标签列宽度小一些

print(final_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("data/figures/5_02_inputs_in_regions.png"),
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 8,
  device = "png",
  dpi = 600
)
tictoc::toc()
```

## plot res sensitivity
```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=2.8, dpi = 300}

tictoc::tic()

text_size <- 8

warm_to_cool_colors <- c(
  "#CC79A7",  # 粉红
  "#D55E00",  # 红褐色
  "#E69F00",  # 橙色（暖）
  "#009E73",   # 绿色（冷）
  "#56B4E9",  # 浅蓝
  "#0072B2"  # 蓝色
)
custom_labels <- c(
  "1_hyper_arid_3_20_30_lat_high_relief"       = "Hyper arid",  
  "2_arid_1_00_10_lat_high_relief"             = "Arid",         
  "3_semiarid_2_10_20_lat_high_relief"         = "Semiarid",    
  "4_dry_subhumid_4_30_40_lat_high_relief"     = "Subhumid",
  "5_humid_6_50_60_lat_high_relief"            = "Humid",     
  "6_perhumid_5_40_50_lat_high_relief"         = "Perhumid" 
)

# 创建散点图 - TWI（不带图例）
p_twi_sens <- ggplot(df_sens_all, aes(x = r_twi_30, y = r_twi_450, color = reg_id)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1,
              color = "firebrick",
              linetype = "dashed",
              linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray90", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray90", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, aes(color = reg_id), 
              alpha = 1, linewidth = 0.7) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.75, 0.75), ylim = c(-0.75, 0.75)) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "r(30)",
    y = "r(450)",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = text_size) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",  # 移除图例
    legend.title = element_text(size = text_size, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = text_size),
    axis.title = element_text(size = text_size),
    axis.text = element_text(size = text_size),
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(size = text_size, face = "bold",
                              margin = margin(b = 3)),
    plot.title.position = "panel",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = warm_to_cool_colors,
                     labels = custom_labels)  # 应用暖色到冷色


# 创建散点图 - Rin（不带图例）
p_rin_sens <- ggplot(df_sens_all, aes(x = r_rin_30, y = r_rin_450, color = reg_id)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1,
              color = "firebrick",
              linetype = "dashed",
              linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray90", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray90", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, aes(color = reg_id), 
              alpha = 1, linewidth = 0.7) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.75, 0.75), ylim = c(-0.75, 0.75)) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "r(30)",
    y = "r(450)",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = text_size) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",  # 移除图例
    legend.title = element_text(size = text_size, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = text_size),
    axis.title = element_text(size = text_size),
    axis.text = element_text(size = text_size),
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(size = text_size, face = "bold",
                              margin = margin(b = 3)),
    plot.title.position = "panel",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = warm_to_cool_colors,
                     labels = custom_labels)  # 应用暖色到冷色

# p_twi_sens
# p_rin_sens
# 合并并添加共享图例
final_plot <- (p_twi_sens | p_rin_sens) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  ) &
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 6, ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE)) &
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = list(c("a)", "b)")),  # 自定义标签
    # 或者
    # tag_levels = c("A", "B"),
    # tag_prefix = "(",
    # tag_suffix = ")"
  )

print(final_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("data/figures/5_02_res_sensitivity_regions.png"),
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 2.8,
  device = "png",
  dpi = 600
)
tictoc::toc()
```
